verdict.rationale: Ollama offers a one-line prebuilt install script (`curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh`) on its download page, and community reports confirm desktop apps for macOS and Windows plus prebuilt ROCm containers, so no source compilation is needed. Missing for 10: first-party docs detailing per-platform installers/packages (e.g. Windows/macOS installers, package managers like Homebrew or apt), and explicit official documentation of container images.
